## Purpose

Find out which of the two new objectives you already work at. Counting and reorder
points are assumed and are not asked about.

## Learning objectives

- Estimate demand from a short run of counts and state the likely error.
- Turn a supplier lead time into an order date.

## Theory

None. This is a check, not a lesson. Answer from what you already do.

## Completion conditions

Each objective has been answered once, and the tutor has recorded a level for it.
